title: Bar list
description: A compact ranked list, two lines per row: the name, then the value, a thin needle bar on a shared track and a change at the right. An earlier value sits on the track as a heartwood diamond with the track carved away around it. Hover and focus step the other rows back.

anatomy.description: The root grid with data-slot="bar-list", role="img" and a spoken summary; data-focus while a row is focused.
One item on a subgrid: label over value, lane and change; data-focused on the focused one; onMouseEnter/Leave report to onHover.
An inline-size container holding the track (the fill from the left, masked around the prior mark) and the prior mark, both placed from the --share custom property.

usage: Pass the domain the rows share ([0, max]) so every bar is drawn on one scale; the component clamps values inside it.
The change slot takes a ReactNode: a DeltaChip is the usual occupant.
The list is controlled for hover: keep focus in the caller and feed it back, or leave both off for a static list.
Chart colours are the track token and needle-700; the prior mark is categorical-3, the palette's one red (theming §5.2).
